text.A: **Ova pravila primjenjuju se gdje god se nalazili.** Pridržavamo se zakonodavstva Ujedinjene Kraljevine o zaštiti podataka, a kada se primjenjuje i zakonodavstvo o zaštiti podataka zemlje u kojoj živite, pridržavamo se i njega.
text.B: **Napomene o alergijama i prehrani.** Prosljeđujemo ih food trucku zajedno s vašom narudžbom i ne upotrebljavamo ih ni za što drugo. Uklanjamo ih, zajedno s vašim imenom i kontaktnim podacima, 12 mjeseci nakon narudžbe (vidjeti odjeljak 7).
text.C: **Međunarodni prijenosi.** Podaci vašeg računa i podaci o narudžbama pohranjuju se i obrađuju u Ujedinjenoj Kraljevini. Neke se stvari obavljaju izvan nje: izdvajanje sadržaja jelovnika i automatski odgovori na WhatsAppu, za koje se upotrebljava Googleova usluga u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; dostava WhatsApp poruka, koju obavlja Meta u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; plaćanja, koja obavlja Stripe u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama; i push obavijesti, koje dostavljaju Apple i Google u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama. Kada podaci napuštaju Ujedinjenu Kraljevinu, prijenos je obuhvaćen propisima Ujedinjene Kraljevine o primjerenosti (UK adequacy regulations) ili ugovorom International Data Transfer Agreement ili dodatkom Addendum, a kada to zahtijeva pravo vaše zemlje, i zaštitnom mjerom koju to pravo priznaje. Možete nas zatražiti pojedinosti o zaštitnim mjerama koje se primjenjuju.
text.G:
Naši [Uvjeti korištenja](/terms) primjenjuju se u svakoj zemlji u kojoj se HatchGrab upotrebljava. Neke zemlje imaju dodatna pravila. Ova ih stranica navodi, zemlju po zemlju.

Kada se neki od odjeljaka u nastavku odnosi na vas, on čini sastavni dio naših Uvjeta korištenja. Ako navodi nešto drukčije od njih, za tu se zemlju primjenjuje ova stranica.

Ako vaša zemlja nije navedena, dodatnih pravila nema: Uvjeti korištenja primjenjuju se onako kako su napisani. Naša [Pravila o privatnosti](/privacy) ista su u svakoj zemlji.

back.A: **These rules [this policy] apply wherever you may be.** We comply with UK data protection legislation, and when the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diet.** We forward them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for anything else. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or by the Addendum, and when the law of your country requires it, also by a safeguard that this law recognises.
back.D: Intro: Under UK data protection legislation and the law of the country you live in, when it applies, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The law of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names or give you additional rights. You have those rights too. / **Submitting a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before we act on a request, we will check whether it is genuine. You can ask someone to submit the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently because you submitted a request. We will reply within one month or earlier if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to reconsider it by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only when the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, contains our postal address and states how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order notifications by SMS, you will receive them only if you agree to it, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will inform you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible when the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First contact us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put things right. You can also submit a complaint to the data protection authority in the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (Office of the Information Commissioner), at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Use] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules.
